user.title: Connect your Škoda account
user.description: Create an API key in the MyŠkoda app (Profile → Smart home → Keys → Create key; or open {api_keys_url} on your phone) and enter it together with the VIN of each vehicle it was created for (separate several VINs with commas).

reauth_confirm.title: Update the Škoda API key
reauth_confirm.description: Your API key is invalid or has expired. Create a new one in the MyŠkoda app (Profile → Smart home → Keys → Create key; or open {api_keys_url} on your phone) and enter it with the VIN(s) of your vehicle(s).

reconfigure.title: Change the Škoda API key
reconfigure.description: Enter a new API key from the MyŠkoda app (Profile → Smart home → Keys → Create key; or open {api_keys_url} on your phone), e.g. before the current one expires. You can also change the VIN(s).

error.invalid_auth: The API key is invalid, expired or not authorized for this vehicle.
error.invalid_vin: Enter valid 17-character VINs, separated by commas.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Škoda API Connect. Please try again later.
error.rate_limited: Škoda API rate limit reached. Please wait a while before trying again.
error.already_configured: This vehicle selection is already configured by another entry.

abort.already_configured: This vehicle selection is already configured.

data.plugged_in_fast_polling: Use the charging interval while the cable is plugged in
data.remove_deleted_profiles: Remove the entities of deleted charging profiles

data_description.notify_targets: Notify services that get a critical alert when a vehicle is parked but not locked and closed, e.g. notify.mobile_app_my_phone. Leave empty for no alerts. The delay is set per vehicle with the "Parking alert grace period" slider.
data_description.spin: The security PIN of your MyŠkoda account. Only needed to start the auxiliary heating. It is stored in Home Assistant like the API key. Leave empty if you do not use it.
data_description.remove_deleted_profiles: When a charging profile was deleted in the vehicle (seen in three polls in a row), its entities are removed from Home Assistant, including their own names and areas. Without it they stay as unavailable entities that you delete by hand.

error.unknown_notify_target: There is no notify service called {target}.

update_charging_profile.name: Update charging profile
update_charging_profile.description: Changes settings, preferred charging times and timers of a charging profile (a saved charging location). Only the fields you give are changed, the rest of the profile stays as it is. Costs two requests of the API quota.

max_charging_current.name: Charging current
max_charging_current.description: MAXIMUM, or REDUCED to limit the current (avoids tripping the circuit breaker).

target_charge.name: Target charge
target_charge.description: Target state of charge in percent.

auto_unlock_plug.name: Unlock plug after charging
auto_unlock_plug.description: Unlock the plug when charging has finished.

min_charge.name: Minimum charge
min_charge.description: Below this state of charge the vehicle charges at once.

min_charge_enabled.name: Minimum charge active
min_charge_enabled.description: Only for vehicles that report it.

preferred_charging_times.name: Preferred charging times
preferred_charging_times.description: List of changes: number (1 to 4), enabled, start and end as HH:MM. Or give the id the API reports (it counts across all profiles) instead of number.

timers.name: Timers
timers.description: List of changes: number (1 to 3), enabled, time as HH:MM, and days (MONDAY to SUNDAY) for a recurring timer or one_off_day for a one-off timer. Or give the id the API reports (it counts across all profiles) instead of number.
